sources_considered.why: Reputable trade report on the planned 2026 home rollout of 1X NEO and its reliance on teleoperation.
Not read; search summary says Musk put private-home sales around 2027.

receipt.public_excerpt: While Neo is designed to be fully autonomous eventually, it isn’t quite there yet. The first wave of robots will be partly controlled via teleoperation.

evidence_items.explanation: Mid-2026 context on a comparable home humanoid: shipments were still planned and the first units relied partly on teleoperation. This bears on the forecast but cannot settle a full-year claim before year-end.

unresolved_gaps: The forecast window runs to 2026-12-31, after the evaluation date.
I found no reliable count of Optimus or Figure units delivered to consumer homes in 2026; search results showed plans and targets only.
Figure's reported production and deliveries (company claims) do not say whether any went to homes.
